messages:
Ravi (PM): quick heads-up 1: we need to finalize the dedicated pools burst cushion and autoscale preemption policy before Q3 roadmap review. customers asking for deterministic behavior.
Mina (Eng): can we default to a 'burst cushion' approach instead of full preemption? smaller graceful reclaim first, then hard evict. reduces churn.
Carlos (SRE): agree on graceful reclaim. call the setting 'cushion_pct' not 'safety_band' 1: ops prefers distinct naming. propose: cushion_pct=12, hard_evict_threshold=5.
Dana (Legal): legal wants explicit opt-out language for any automatic evictions in contracts. also need notice window for preemptions > 30s.
Sam (Product Ops): UX idea: show real-time "Pool cushion" and "Eviction mode" in console. default mode = "graceful". add tooltip explaining customer impact.
Mina (Eng): implementation notes: two-stage reclaim
1) graceful reclaim: reduce burst tokens, send reclaim signal to client, delay 30s
2) hard evict: drain and migrate sessions
We need a migration API for sticky sessions.
Ravi (PM): good. launch acceptance checklist draft:
- API for per-tenant eviction preference
- default values and ability to tune per-pool
- telemetry: cushion_usage_pct, graceful_reclaims, hard_evictions, migrate_fail_rate
- console UI + contract opt-out copy
- pilot w/ 3 customers (EU latency-critical, US bursty, APAC test tenant)
Carlos (SRE): telemetry addition: add alert when migrate_fail_rate > 1% for 5m. also p95 eviction latency.
Mina (Eng): config sketch (YAML):
```
reserved_pools:
  default_cushion_pct: 12
  hard_evict_threshold_pct: 5
  reclaim_wait_seconds: 30
  eviction_mode: graceful # options: graceful|immediate
  allow_auto_evict_by_default: false
```
Dana (Legal): add: "Customers may opt-out of automatic hard eviction via contract amendment; default product setting is opt-in false for enterprise tiers." I'll draft precise clause.
Sam (Product Ops): pilots: I'll reach out to 3 candidates and prep runbook. we should stage pilot in a canary pool first.
Ravi (PM): Mina/Carlos, estimate dev + infra effort?
Mina (Eng): dev: 2w core reclaim + API, 1w migration API, 1w console wiring, 1w e2e tests = 5w.
Carlos (SRE): infra + dashboards: 1w. runbook + oncall pairing: 1w.
Ravi (PM): ok target: pilot kickoff in 7 weeks. Sam take ownership of outreach. Dana finish draft contract language by EOW.
capacity-bot: created ticket CAP-3371: "burst-cushion + two-stage-evict pilot" assigned to @Mina, due 2026-05-15. :spiral_calendar: 
Sam (Product Ops): small ask: in console copy use "Burst cushion" and show numeric % with hover state explaining reclaimed vs evicted. legal liked that.
Mina (Eng): one more technical flag: add "sticky_session_migration": true to avoid cold-kv thrash during migration. will surface as per-tenant opt-in.
Ravi (PM): perfect. action items: Mina RFC + PR, Carlos dashboard PR, Dana contract blurb, Sam pilot list. Drop blockers here or DM me. :rocket:
